ns2:course.label: Ophthalmology
ns2:course.description: Clerkship in ophthalmology for VM-4 professional students. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated to a maximum of 3 hours. Prerequisite: Fourth-year standing in the veterinary medicine professional curriculum.
